source.texts: Paths, parameter and field names, types, enums and error codes match the public Web API 1.0.0.

info.title: Web API
info.description: Public data of this game (users, rooms, groups, badges, achievements, marketplace) and the Wired Variables API that lets a program outside the game read and write a room's wired variables. Paths, parameters and answers follow the public Web API 1.0.0, so client libraries written for it work here with only the host changed.

placeholders.${ZEL_SERVER_ID}: the game's server id, the start of every unique id

ids.room: r-${ZEL_SERVER_ID}-<32 hex> (uniqueId); /rooms/{roomId} takes the numeric id
ids.text: Unique ids look like ${ZEL_SERVER_ID}-<32 hex>, starting with this game's server id. They never change for an account, room or group. An id that starts with another game's server id passes the format check and answers not-found.

targetIds.furni-bc: Build Pass floor furni: the in-room id minus 2147418112 (0x7FFF0000), so 0..65535
targetIds.wall-items-bc: Build Pass wall furni: the in-room id minus 2147418112
targetIds.text: The Wired Variables API counts Build Pass furni as kinds of their own, with small ids.

dates.roomAndMember: room creationTime, group member memberSince: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+00:00
dates.wired: creation_time, update_time: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds (2026-10-26T18:02:11.000Z)

conventions.values: Wired values are signed 64-bit integers (-9223372036854775808..9223372036854775807), stored as such. They are answered as decimal strings ("-42"), so no digit is lost; a request may send a decimal string ("+5" and "007" are read as 5 and 7) or a whole JSON number (also past 2^53: its digits are kept). In game the client shows a value past -2147483648..2147483647 at that end of the range, while the value itself goes on (time subvariables read the real time).

errors.public: {"error":"not-found"} with status 404 for anything unknown or hidden; {"errors":[{"param","msg","value"}]} (also 404) when a user id or name fails the format check.
errors.wired: {"error":"<code>"}; inside a batch result {"code","message"}. A body that is not JSON answers 400 with the plain text page "Bad JSON" (text/html), before any other check.
errors.routes: A path or method without an endpoint answers a plain HTML 404 page ("Cannot GET <path>").

headers.cors: Any site may call the API from a browser: the request's Origin is echoed in Access-Control-Allow-Origin with Vary: Origin, and never with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials (the API reads no cookie, so a browser sends none). Preflights (OPTIONS) answer 204 and allow GET, HEAD, PUT, PATCH, POST, DELETE and the headers asked for.
headers.etag: Every JSON and XML answer has a weak ETag; a GET with a matching If-None-Match answers 304 without a body.
headers.rateLimit: Wired Variables limits are per room; a 429 carries Retry-After. No rate-limit headers otherwise.

none.text: No key. A logged-in player can read it; for everyone else it answers 401 login-required unless the game's operator opens the Web API to everyone.

wiredRead.name: X-Wired-Read-Key
wiredRead.text: The read key the Web API box in the room generated.

wiredWrite.name: X-Wired-Write-Key
wiredWrite.text: The write key the Web API box in the room generated.

wiredReadWrite.text: The read key for the GET operations of a batch and the write key for the others (a batch of only writes needs only the write key).

auth.howToGetKeys: Place the "Variable Global Add-on: Web API" box in your room and open it. Press Generate next to the read key and/or the write key, then Apply: a generated key only counts after Apply, and only a key generated since the box was opened can be applied. Until then the old key keeps working. The box owner sees the saved keys whenever they open the box, and Copy copies one. To delete a key, empty its field and Apply; a deleted key can never be saved again. Picking the box up deletes both keys. Keys work for that room only, while the box owner owns the room or has rights there. Do not share keys.

groups.name: default
groups.text: Public data of users, rooms, groups, badges, achievements and the marketplace. No key needed.

groups.name: Wired Variables
groups.text: Read and write a room's wired variables from outside the game, with the keys of the room's Web API box. Values written here count as origin "External" for WIRED Trigger: Variable Changed.

groups.name: extradata
groups.text: Photo endpoints outside the documented API that client libraries use.

enforced.text: This game refuses only above its per-address guard's numbers.
This game refuses only above its per-address guard's numbers.

wired.batchWrites.text: Write operations inside batches and profile writes, counted one by one.

public.text: This game's own guard per client address on every endpoint.

rateLimits.source: Wired limits use a 60 s window and a 10 s burst; count answers are cached for 20 s to 10 min, longer for bigger counts.

login-required.text: The caller is not logged in and the game's operator has not opened this part of the Web API to everyone.

not-found.text: Nothing found: unknown user, room, group or path value, or a user who hides their profile. All of them get this one body.

user.invalid_id.text: The user id is not a unique id (<server id>-<32 hex>). Sent in the errors[] form, with status 404.

user.invalid_name.text: The name parameter is missing or empty. errors[] form, status 404; value is left out when the parameter was not sent at all.

maintenance.text: The backend could not answer (database or game server down).

too-many-requests.text: This game's own guard: one address sent too many requests.

request-failed-non-200.text: The value cannot be read as a signed 64-bit integer ("abc", "1.5", 9223372036854775808, true), or a field of the body has the wrong type. In a batch or a profile PATCH the whole request fails and nothing is written.

room.not_found.text: The room exists but could not be loaded. An unknown room id answers {"error":"not-found"} instead.

wired.variables.invalid_target.text: Unknown target kind for this scope, or a variable name that cannot exist.

wired.variables.key_missing.text: The room has no saved key of the kind this request needs: no Web API box, no key applied, the key was deleted or the box was picked up. Answered whatever key headers are sent. A batch also gets it when the header one of its operations needs is not sent.

wired.variables.key_invalid.text: The room has a saved key of that kind, and the request does not carry it: the header is missing or empty, the key is wrong, or it is the other kind of key.

wired.variables.api_disabled.text: The Wired Variables API is switched off on this game, or the box whose key was used no longer works in the room (picked up, or its owner no longer owns the room or has rights there).

wired.variables.operation_not_allowed.text: This write is not possible on this variable (for example it has no value, or it is read-only).

wired.variables.user_not_participating.text: The user holds no value of the room's user variables, so they cannot be given one: never in the room, or every value taken away (also while standing in the room). A user who stands in the room but never held a value is refused the same way. A user who was there and left with a stored value can still be written.

wired.variables.bulk_delete_empty.text: The variables list is missing or empty.

wired.variables.bulk_delete_invalid_vari.text: A name in the list is not a user or furni variable the API can reach in this room.

wired.variables.bulk_delete_not_enabled.text: "Allow mass deletion" is not ticked in the room's Web API box.

wired.variables.batch_empty.text: The requests list is missing or empty.

wired.variables.entity_not_found.text: The user, pet, bot or furni of the profile does not exist (in this room).

wired.variables.not_found.text: The variable does not exist in this room, or the target does not have it.

wired.variables.too_many_requests.text: The room used up its request budget; wait for the number of seconds in Retry-After.

htmlNotFound.text: A path or method no endpoint has. Answered with a plain HTML page ("Cannot GET /api/public/nope").

endpoints.summary: List every achievement of the game.
endpoints.description: Gives the whole achievement list of this game with the score each level needs. The list belongs to this game; other games have their own.
notes: levelRequirements is an empty list for achievements without levels.
creationTime is a date without time.

endpoints.summary: List the achievements of a user.
endpoints.description: Gives every achievement the user has made progress in, with the level reached and the current score. Level 0 means the first level is not reached yet. Answers for users who hide their profile too.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique id of the user (${ZEL_SERVER_ID}-<32 hex>).

404.description: Unknown user, or an id in the wrong format.

differsFromBaseSpec: Items carry level and score instead of levelRequirements.

endpoints.summary: Count the owners of a badge.
endpoints.description: Tells how many users own the badge, with its name and description in this game's language. The count ignores upper and lower case; the name and description need the code's exact case.

params.name: badgeCode
params.description: Badge code, for example ACH_Login1 or ADM.

200.description: The count. An unknown code also answers 200, with count 0 and the code as its name. A code in another case (adm for ADM) counts the same owners but answers with the code as sent as its name and an empty description.

404.description: Documented, but never sent: unknown codes answer 200.

differsFromBaseSpec: An unknown badge code answers 200 with ownerCount 0.
The count ignores the code's case, the texts do not: /badge/owners/adm counts the ADM owners but answers name "adm", description "".

endpoints.summary: Get one group.
endpoints.description: Gives a group's public details by its unique id.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique id of the group (g-${ZEL_SERVER_ID}-<32 hex>).

404.description: Unknown group, or an id in any other format.

endpoints.summary: List the members of a group.
endpoints.description: Gives up to 1000 members of the group, admins and owner included, in the order they joined. There are no pages.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique id of the group (g-${ZEL_SERVER_ID}-<32 hex>).

notes: memberSince is when the member's account was made, not when they joined.
A pageNumber query parameter is ignored.

endpoints.summary: Marketplace numbers for several furni at once.
endpoints.description: Takes lists of floor and wall furni class names and answers each with its marketplace history of the last 30 days and the offers open now. Prices are in credits.

200.description: The numbers, one entry per requested furni.

400.description: roomItems or wallItems has more than 25 furni. The same answer whichever list is too long.

default.message: Too many items in the request. The maximum allowed is 25 per type.

404.description: The body is not a JSON object, or roomItems / wallItems (each optional) is not a list of {item} objects or class names.

differsFromBaseSpec: Each entry also has extraData (null for plain furni).
More than 25 furni in a list answers 400 {"status":"NOK","message":"Too many items in the request. The maximum allowed is 25 per type."}.
notes: At most 25 furni per list (25 floor and 25 wall furni in one request); above that 400 with status NOK.
Prices are what a buyer pays: the seller's price plus the 1% commission.
Days are UTC days. An offer stays open for 168 hours (7 days).
Limited editions are left out, so extraData is always null here.
A class name the game does not know gets an entry of zeros.

endpoints.summary: Check that the API is up.
endpoints.description: Answers 200 with an empty body when the backend works, 503 when it does not.

200.description: Up. Empty body, no content type.

503.description: Down (the database does not answer). Empty body.

endpoints.summary: Get one room.
endpoints.description: Gives a room's public details by its numeric id. groupId is only there when the room has a group.

params.name: roomId
params.description: Numeric room id (the unique id r-${ZEL_SERVER_ID}-... is not accepted here).

404.description: Unknown room, an id that is not a number, or a room of the game's own system account (it has no unique id).

differsFromBaseSpec: publicRoom and doorMode are sent; groupId is left out when the room has no group.

endpoints.summary: List the featured looks.
endpoints.description: Gives a short list of popular avatar looks as XML (no XML declaration, one line).
notes: hash identifies the look; it is not a hash anyone needs to recompute.
Every answer is 10 looks picked at random from the game's featured looks list (the one the avatar editor shows), so two answers usually differ.

endpoints.summary: Find a user by name.
endpoints.description: Gives a user's public details by name; upper and lower case do not matter. A user who hides their profile shows only their name, look, motto and wearing nothing. Send the ETag of an earlier answer in If-None-Match to get 304 when nothing changed.

params.name: name
params.description: The user's name.

params.name: If-None-Match
params.description: ETag of an earlier answer.

selectedBadges.description: For being a member of the community for 56 days.

selectedBadges.name: 100% True Player V
selectedBadges.description: For being a member of the community for 56 days.

304.description: Not changed since the ETag in If-None-Match. No body.

404.description: No user with that name, or name missing or empty.

endpoints.summary: List the variables of a room.
endpoints.description: Gives the names of the variables the API can reach in the room, grouped by scope.

params.name: roomId
params.description: Numeric id of the room.

params.name: X-Wired-Read-Key
params.description: Read key from the room's Web API box.

notes: Only permanent user, furni and room variables are listed; variables that last while the user or room is active are not, and the API cannot reach them.
The API sees the variables as they were set up when the room last loaded: a variable box placed or changed while the room is loaded shows up after everyone has left and the room has loaded again.

endpoints.summary: Run up to 50 operations on one variable.
endpoints.description: Runs a list of 1 to 50 GET, PUT, PATCH and DELETE operations on the variable named in the path, in order. Each operation names its target as <targetKind>/<entityId> and gets its own result, carrying the op_id it was sent with. GET operations need the read key, the others the write key.

params.name: roomId
params.description: Numeric id of the room.

params.name: scope
params.description: user or furni. Any other value is not routed (plain HTML 404).

params.name: variableName
params.description: Name of the variable as set up in the room.

params.name: X-Wired-Read-Key
params.description: Read key from the room's Web API box.

params.name: X-Wired-Write-Key
params.description: Write key from the room's Web API box.

429.description: Too many requests for this room.

notes: The read key is needed when the batch has a GET operation, the write key when it has any other; a needed header that is not sent answers key_missing for the whole batch.
A PUT or PATCH without a value, or an unknown method, fails only that operation (400 wired.variables.invalid_target). A leading slash in path is fine.
A value that cannot be read fails the whole batch with 400 request-failed-non-200, and nothing runs.
differsFromBaseSpec: Every result carries status, body, error and op_id, with null where empty.
